stories.headline: Andreas Almgren wins the New York City Marathon
stories.summary: The 2026 New York City Marathon was the 55th edition of the race and was run on Sunday 1 November. Around 60,000 runners started. Andreas Almgren won the men's division in his marathon debut, and became the first Swede to win the race in any division.

stories.headline: Tampa Bay win without completing a single pass
stories.summary: Heavy rain in Tampa made for difficult conditions, and Baker Mayfield made only three pass attempts and completed none of them. The Buccaneers still beat the Atlanta Falcons 16-0, the first National Football League team to win a game without completing a pass since the Buffalo Bills in 1974. Bucky Irving and Kenneth Gainwell both rushed for over 100 yards as Tampa Bay put up a franchise record 324 yards on the ground.

stories.headline: First generic approved for a twice-yearly HIV injection
stories.summary: The United States Food and Drug Administration has approved the first generic version of lenacapavir, a twice-yearly injection that prevents HIV. The generic is expected to cost about US$40 annually in 120 low- and middle-income countries.

stories.headline: The first fossil ape found in North Africa
stories.summary: A fossil ape recovered from Wadi Moghra in northern Egypt has been named Masripithecus moghraensis. It lived approximately 17 to 18 million years ago, during the Early Miocene, and is the first definitive fossil ape ever discovered in North Africa. The remains consist only of lower jaw material.

sources.excerpt: The 2026 New York City Marathon was the 55th edition of the annual marathon race in New York City that took place on Sunday, November 1, 2026.

In his marathon debut, Andreas Almgren became the first Swede to win the race in any division, the 13th nationality to win the men's division, and 25th nationality added to all the division champions.

Tampa Bay Buccaneers refuse to complete a pass during its 16-0 victory against the rival Atlanta Falcons in Week 8, becoming the first National Football League team to win a game without completing a pass since the Buffalo Bills did so in 1974.
Heavy rain made for sloppy, wet, and difficult conditions. Quarterback Baker Mayfield made only three pass attempts, and failed to complete a single pass.
The Buccaneers became the second team in the Super Bowl era, and first team since the 1974 Buffalo Bills to finish (and win) a game without completing a pass.
Running backs Bucky Irving and Kenneth Gainwell both rushed for over 100 yards each, as the Buccaneers put up a franchise record 324 yards on the ground.

The United States Food and Drug Administration approves the first generic version of lenacapavir, a twice-yearly HIV prevention injection expected to cost about US$40 annually in 120 low- and middle-income countries.

The newly identified species, named Masripithecus moghraensis, lived approximately 17 to 18 million years ago during the Early Miocene. Its fossilized remains were recovered from Wadi Moghra in northern Egypt, making it the first definitive fossil ape ever discovered in North Africa.
Although the remains consist only of lower jaw material, they contain an unusual combination of anatomical features that distinguishes the animal from other apes of similar age.
